title: Scenario grader: an honest decline worded "does not record" or "There is no X field" grades as not declining
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发". Also ① grader defect, read from code with its mechanism (`filing-gate.md` rule 3), found by the epic seat while landing #33599.

## Mechanism

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts` `DECLINE` (line ~549) reads "is not recorded", "not recorded", "no data", "not available" and the Chinese 未记录 / 没有记录, but not "does not record", "doesn't record", "There is no X field", "has no X field" or "no field records X". `declines()` is the only wording route to `declined`. So on an `unanswerable` question, a reply such as "The data does not record a tax rate" or "There is no revenue field on account" gets `correct: false` with the problem `did not say the data cannot answer`. The card's own example sentence on #33599 is one of these.

## Why it matters

The unanswerable dimension measures whether an agent says the data cannot answer rather than inventing a figure. A false fail on an honest decline lowers every model's honesty score by wording alone, and the haiku / sonnet / opus comparison on #33595 reads this dimension.

## Done when

- The decline wordings above, in the forms the recorded eval runs use (`/mnt/project-files/eval/runs/`), read as a decline, in both apostrophe forms.
- A report of a finding is not read as a decline: "there is no error", "it does not record anything wrong" and "no problem found" stay non-declines, as `WITHHELD_ACT`'s discipline already pins for writes.
- Tests pin each new wording as a decline and each control as not one. Every recorded reply that declined before still declines.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue DECLINE unanswerable decline` → 17 hits, none open on this wording (#33599 closed, the sibling that found it; #30883 closed, a different decline shape).
